hi: हाँ हेलो, मेरा नाम राहुल है, मैं आपके बैंक का पुराना कस्टमर हूँ।
literal: Yes hello, my name is Rahul, I am your bank's old customer.
fluent: Hello, my name is Rahul; I'm a long-time customer of your bank.

hi: मैंने पिछले महीने एक रिक्वेस्ट डाली थी अपना पुराना सेविंग अकाउंट बंद करने की।
literal: Last month I had put in a request to close my old saving account.
fluent: Last month I submitted a request to close my old savings account.

hi: लेकिन अभी तक अकाउंट बंद नहीं हुआ, और उसमें से चार्जेस भी कट रहे हैं।
literal: But until now the account has not closed, and charges are also being cut from it.
fluent: But the account still hasn't been closed, and charges are still being deducted from it.

hi: दूसरी बात, मुझे एक होम लोन के बारे में पूछना था।
literal: Second thing, I had to ask about a home loan.
fluent: Also, I wanted to ask about a home loan.

hi: लोन अमाउंट लगभग पाँच लाख… नहीं नहीं, पाँच करोड़ का चाहिए।
literal: Loan amount about five lakh... no no, five crore is needed.
fluent: I need a loan of about five crore.

hi: कितने साल का टेन्योर मिलेगा, और इंटरेस्ट रेट क्या चल रहा अभी?
literal: How many years' tenure will I get, and what interest rate is going on now?
fluent: What tenure can I get, and what's the current interest rate?

hi: और इसके लिए कौन कौन से डॉक्यूमेंट्स लगेंगे?
literal: And for this which which documents will be needed?
fluent: And which documents will I need for this?
